annotations.title: Weigh Station: check an x402 service before paying

description: Free. Probes any x402 endpoint WITHOUT paying and reports what it actually charges, to which wallet, on which network, and how that compares with its public Coinbase Bazaar listing (price, recipient, distinct payers in the last 30 days). Returns facts and named signals such as pay_to_differs_from_listing; it does not score or recommend. Works for services that have nothing to do with Tollkit. Read-only: it sends one unpaid request, the way any buyer asks for a price, and never pays or changes anything.
